title: Loading list
description: Five steps of a job, each with a spinner that turns into a tick or a cross. The state of a step is one attribute.

fragments.title: A step with three icons
fragments.note: Each icon follows data-status on the row and plays its own state for one value.

fragments.title: Set a step's status
fragments.note: The API is one function. Call it from your own process.

fragments.title: A made-up process
fragments.note: Timers stand in for real work. A failure stops the run.

fragments.title: Retry from the failed step
fragments.note: The same run(), started from where it stopped.

fragments.title: One cell, three icons
fragments.note: The stylesheet shows the icon for the status.

fragments.title: Faint, then solid
fragments.note: The icons inherit color through current-color.
